name: Juro round coffee table, solid oak, oil finish, diameter 90 x 36 (Javorina, via IDANA)
materials: solid oak (page: 'עץ אלון מלא'), oil finish, oil kit included
texture: oak grain under oil; top thickness and base construction not stated

warm-modern.reason: Estimate: round solid-oak top gives a real choice of form against Olia and is light and open, but 90 cm is far below the 120-140 length (ratio 0.41 of the sofa) and the price is high.

notes: FB12-T swap-table line, Israeli stores round, 2026-11-25. Read from the official product page, no contact. FORM CHOICE: round top, differs from Olia (rectangular waterfall). FAILS the A.3 length (90 vs 120-140): suitable only as a deliberate small round alternative, or as a side table; the designer decides. Page shows 2 sizes (diameter 90 x 36 and diameter 68 x 28); the technical sheet applies to the 90. PRICE DISCREPANCY: the product page shows 6,500 ILS, the collection grid shows 'from 4,800' (probably the 68 cm size); not verified which price applies to the 90. Finishes by name: cafe, natural, bleached, walnut tone; only 'natural' fits L* 56-66 (UNVERIFIED, colours estimated by name, photos not sampled). The spec sheet lists the material as 'Smoked oak' while the text says solid oak: contradiction, check before ordering. Base shape, top thickness and edge profile NOT stated. Photos: 11 on the page, I could not tell studio packshots from real home photos (alt text generic), so 'real unit' is UNVERIFIED. Weight 25 kg, flat-pack, 12-month warranty, in stock (page: 'זמין במלאי'), lead time not stated. SHIPPING TO ISRAEL, two options: cheapest = pickup from the supplier warehouse by prior arrangement (cost not published); fastest reasonable = delivery by the supplier, fee not stated on this page (other IDANA pages show 120-450 ILS), area Hadera to Ashkelon to Modi'in only. Photo rights unclear. Not on sale until written supplier approval (rule C.0).
